description: This file defines the ScopeRepository class implementing the ScopeRepositoryInterface for OAuth scope management within the OrangeHRM project. It provides stub methods for retrieving scope entities and finalizing scopes, currently returning null and empty arrays respectively.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 scope repository interface with stub methods for scope retrieval and finalization.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the scope entity by its identifier; currently returns null as scopes are not supported.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes a set of scopes for a request; currently returns an empty array indicating no scopes are defined.
